reason: Collagen for my joints after training is something I'd actually use, and £18 one-off is fair. But it says 'halal-certified' and doesn't tell me who by, and I don't put a supplement in my body until I know the certifying body.
objection: Halal-certified by whom? Plenty of brands say halal on the label and the certifier turns out to be someone nobody trusts. Until I see the name and can check it myself, it's a no.
would_change_my_mind: The certifying body named clearly on the pouch and the site, one I recognise like HMC or HFA, with the certificate I can check. Then I'd buy one pouch, not the subscription.
